leftEvidence.title: Sacrifice is not desired, and the speaker says ears were opened

points.label: Body wording
points.left: The WEBU psalm says, “you have opened my ears.”
points.right: The WEBU quotation says, “you prepared a body for me.”

points.label: Setting
points.left: The speaker delights to do God’s will.
points.right: Hebrews places the words on Christ entering the world.

payload.posture: Hold both Scripture sources together. Keep their actors, gifts, places, sequence, genre, and stated effects distinct.

rightEvidence.title: Sacrifice is not desired, and a body is prepared

payload.tension: Hebrews attributes wording to the psalm that differs at a material phrase in the supplied WEBU texts.
payload.title: Opened ears and a prepared body
